analyst_pushback.issue: How achieve 11% margin when 10.9% normalized and facing high prior-year base?
analyst_pushback.response: Multiple initiatives (lower karatage, GC Max, sourcing) plus studded mix improvement will drive H2 margins

analyst_pushback.issue: Can double-digit growth be achieved if gold price inflation becomes zero?
analyst_pushback.response: Buyer and ticket size are linked; India's love for gold and growth story endure; headroom huge

analyst_pushback.issue: Is competitive pressure easing with stable gold prices now?
analyst_pushback.response: No easing observed; intensity remains elevated though regional variations exist, e.g. Gujarat

analyst_pushback.issue: Will cash-for-gold exchange program create margin headwind versus jewellery exchange?
analyst_pushback.response: Program structured margin-neutral via deductions; no specific basis points to attribute
